title: 88 Nic Mixed Berries Nicotine Pouches
description: 88Nic Berries tastes bright and juicy, bringing together red and dark Berry notes with a gentle sweetness and a clean finish. The flavour stays clear throughout use without becoming heavy or overly sweet. Each pouch sits neatly under the lip, releasing nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or odour. Each can includes 20 pouches. Choose from 6mg (Medium) for a softer release or 12mg (Extra Strong) for a more pronounced dose. The format is simple to use and designed for everyday convenience. Nicotine Ranges: Medium - 6mg this is best for regular users. Extra Strong - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
